turnkey.title: Turnkey supply
turnkey.body: A full cycle of work: selecting the right configuration for the laboratory's tasks, delivery, installation, commissioning and staff training. You get a turnkey laboratory that's ready to work, with support at every stage.

service.title: 24/7 service
service.body: Round-the-clock technical support across the Republic of Uzbekistan. Our engineers train at the manufacturers' factories, so faults are resolved quickly with minimal downtime.

standards.title: International standards
standards.body: We work directly with global laboratory and medical diagnostics leaders. Equipment and reagents comply with ISO, FDA and European Pharmacopoeia standards.

education.title: Education
education.body: Together with the Tashkent Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education, we develop training materials and hold seminars and conferences with international experts, helping lab specialists advance their skills.

about.panelText: Official distributor of premium laboratory diagnostics equipment in Uzbekistan. Delivery, commissioning, training and service — across the full life cycle of the instrument.

aboutPage.title: Your trusted partner in equipping the laboratory
aboutPage.intro1: Albatros Health Care was founded in 2017 to bring modern technology into the practice of clinical diagnostic laboratories in Uzbekistan. Today we are one of the leading distributors of medical laboratory equipment and laboratory and medical diagnostics solutions in the country, representing 13 global brands: SNIBE, BD, Randox, Dymind, Werfen, Lifotronic, URIT, Illumina, Condalab, Clarius, TruScreen and others. More than 2,000 clinics and laboratories across the country trust us to equip their labs.
aboutPage.intro2: The company's mission is turnkey equipment supply backed by fast methodological and service support for our partners. Our team includes specialists with higher specialized education who regularly train at the manufacturers' factories. We regularly organize international conferences and seminars featuring foreign experts in clinical biochemistry and molecular biology.
aboutPage.slogan: Albatros Health Care — your trusted partner in equipping and supporting the laboratory.

catalog.title: Catalog of laboratory and diagnostic equipment
catalog.subtitle: Laboratory and diagnostic equipment, reagents, consumables and quality control from world-leading laboratory and medical diagnostics brands.

directionDesc.equipment: Automatic analyzers and laboratory systems for clinical diagnostics: immunochemistry, biochemistry, hematology, hemostasis, microbiology and molecular diagnostics. Equipment from world manufacturers is supplied turnkey, with installation, commissioning, staff training and service support throughout the instrument's service life.
directionDesc.reagents: Diagnostic reagents and test systems for all study groups: hormones, tumor markers, infections, cardiac markers, biochemistry, hematology and hemostasis indicators. Supplied as original kits from the equipment manufacturers, ensuring stable results, compatibility with the analyzers and compliance with international laboratory diagnostics quality standards.
directionDesc.consumables: Consumables for uninterrupted analyzer operation: cuvettes, tips, wash and system solutions, cartridges and starter kits. Original consumables are matched to specific equipment models, help avoid downtime, maintain measurement accuracy and extend instrument service life under a lab's high daily workload.
directionDesc.controls: Control materials and calibrators for in-lab quality control and analyzer calibration. They ensure result reliability and reproducibility, compliance with regulatory requirements and readiness for external quality assessment. Selected to match the lab's methods and equipment, covering biochemistry, hemostasis, immunochemistry, urinalysis and other directions.
